phase_name: Documentation sync, deploy, precedent verification, full gate

objectives.description: Add generated-surface subsection to state-management-schema.md's file-scope section; confirm harvester header coherence
Deploy via deploy-headless.sh and confirm deployed harvester matches source-store copy
Precedent verification: replay deployed harvester against both task 749 and task 750 plans; measure latency; confirm no retroactive file_scope mutation; run the complete verify-deploy.sh gate

notes: Deploy result: [deploy-headless] RESULT=landed_verify_clean. Deployed plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, test-plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, and state-management-schema.md all byte-identical to the source-store copies (diff -q confirmed).

Precedent replay (deployed harvester): task 749's plan now yields its full pre-fix baseline set plus FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, README.md, and typst/generated/status.typ. Task 750's plan likewise. Neither narrow surface (automation-module-map.typ, machine-appendix.*) fires on either precedent, as expected.

Latency: Phase 1 baseline (gate present, no appends yet) measured ~0.147s wall-clock on task 750's plan; final (all four surface categories active) measured ~0.129s -- the difference is within measurement noise, confirming the Risks table's 'orders of magnitude smaller than lake-build-backed gates' claim rather than a literal regression.
Non-retroactive-mutation check: git diff -- specs/state.json shows no file_scope change for either precedent task.
Full gate: bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh exits 0 (14 checks, 0 failures) both before and after the Cases-11-12 fix below.

DISCOVERED AND FIXED during this phase's own full-gate run: test-plan-file-scope-harvest.sh's Cases 11-12 were environment-dependent (relied on resolve_repo_root()'s CWD-based git fallback silently resolving to whatever repo the suite was invoked from). Fixed by pinning CWD to WORKDIR for those two invocations. Re-verified 32/32 passing and the three-suite run-all.sh --only selection green in BOTH the source-store checkout and the deployed BimodalLogic tree. See issues.jsonl for the full record.

Territory note: sibling task 754 (status: implementing) declares .claude/context/reference/state-management-schema.md in its own file_scope, contradicting this plan's own Risk-table claim of no intersection. Verified at edit time that the source-store counterpart had no uncommitted changes and its last commit predated this cycle; made a narrow, additive, single-subsection edit and re-read immediately before writing to minimize the collision window. See issues.jsonl.
